thread:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 — elevated 5xx rate on staging gateway (/v1/generate). Region: eu-west-1. Paging maria (oncall). Incident ID INC-2026-042.

maria: ack, I'm on it — starting with router logs and recent deploy history.

maria: quick log peek:
```
[2026-04-07T15:02:10Z] gateway v2-staging -> 500 internal: kvcache lookup failed, key not found
[2026-04-07T15:02:11Z] gateway v2-staging -> 502 upstream timeout
errors ~12% over last 3m
```

josh: @maria good to know. i'm free to take handoff if you want to focus on mitigation. any suspected deploy?

maria: suspect kv-cache invalidation from yesterday's proxy rollout to v2-staging, yes. Mitigation plan: rolling restart of gateway pods to repopulate caches, and enable prefix cache bypass for writes. Kicking restart now.

maria: executing: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway-v2 -n staging --label=pool=staging-gateway` (rolling, 30s interval)

carla: drafting status page initial note — will paste then iterate. Need to be careful calling out scope: only staging/dev accounts.

carla: DRAFT (initial):
```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some requests to the /v1/generate endpoint in eu-west-1 (staging environment) are returning 5xx errors for a subset of developer/test accounts.
Customer impact: Limited to staging/dev customers; production traffic unaffected.
Action: On-call has paged and is performing rolling restarts of the staging gateway. We'll post updates as we confirm progress.
ETA: next update in 15 minutes.
```

dave: +1 on limited scope — ops telemetry shows production clusters unchanged. Recommend adding a line about retries and advising customers to retry requests.

carla: updated draft with retry note. New line: "Retrying requests is recommended; transient failures expected to resolve as restarts complete."

josh: LGTM. Who will publish? I can push the initial status page if legal/comms not required for staging-only events.

maria: status: restart started at 15:06 UTC, rolling through 6 pods. Observed error rate dropping to ~6% after 2 pods restarted.

incident-bot: Auto-update: error rate trending down — 5xx now 4.8% (5m window).

carla: thanks — I'll do the publish. Publishing initial notice now to internal statusboard & staging status page.

carla: published initial update. Copy pasted above. tagging: #ops, #devex, @support-team for awareness.

josh: nice. recommend follow-ups at +15m and +60m unless resolved earlier. Also suggest a resolved notice template ready.

maria: restart finished at 15:16 UTC. Post-restart metrics: 5xx down to 1.2% and falling. A few pods repopulating cache; KV lookups succeeding.

dave: verified from customer telemetry: no retry escalations. Production unaffected. Good to prepare resolved blurb.

carla: RESOLVED DRAFT (ready):
```
Status: Resolved
Impact: Some developer/test accounts in eu-west-1 (staging) experienced intermittent 5xx errors to /v1/generate.
What changed: On-call performed a rolling restart of the staging gateway pool; error rate returned to baseline.
Customer impact: Limited to staging/dev traffic — production customers were not affected.
Follow-up: We'll review the proxy rollout that triggered cache invalidation and add a guard to prevent future cache misses.
```

josh: text looks good. Add a note with the incident ID INC-2026-042 and timestamp of resolution.

carla: added incident ID and resolution time (15:16 UTC). Publishing resolved notice to staging status page and internal ops channel now.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 marked resolved by carla at 15:17 UTC. Closing pager.

maria: handing off post-incident review to josh for root-cause writeup. I'll add logs and pod restart timeline to the ticket.

josh: taking RCA. Will follow up with a short postmortem and mitigation actions (config guard for cache invalidation + deploy checklist).

carla: thanks team. Quick lessons: flagging staging vs prod clearly in future status copy helped reduce noise. :white_check_mark:

dave: thanks everyone — closing thread.
